openf1.name: OpenF1 historical data API
openf1.license_note: OpenF1 is an independent public data service and is not Formula 1 or FIA data.
openf1.fields: Tyre compound/stint, pit-lane timing and weather samples.

open_meteo.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
open_meteo.fields: Hourly reanalysis temperature, precipitation, wind and WMO weather code at circuit coordinates.

jolpica.name: Jolpica Ergast-compatible schedule endpoint
jolpica.fields: Circuit coordinates used by the Open-Meteo query.

limitations: OpenF1 rainfall is a binary observation, not a millimetre measurement.
Open-Meteo precipitation is a weather-grid reanalysis estimate, not a circuit rain-gauge reading.
Missing source fields remain null and are never inferred.
This bundle is informational and does not alter the exact historical replay.

display.condition: Rain observed in OpenF1 race-session samples
display.source_note: OpenF1 weather is session-sampled; millimetre precipitation is an Open-Meteo three-hour reanalysis-window estimate.

availability.note: An empty driver array means the applicable OpenF1 endpoint returned no record. No tyre compound, pit stop, or duration is inferred.
